item.title: The leader of a Kenyan doomsday cult is sentenced to 200 years in prison
item.description: The leader of a Kenyan doomsday cult linked to the deaths of more than 400 people was sentenced on Friday to 200 years in prison for the murders of 191 people. The High Court in Kenya’s coastal city of Mombasa issued the sentence for Pastor Paul Mackenzie. He was convicted of murdering 190 children and one adult after he ordered his followers to starve themselves to death to meet Jesus. Justice Diana Kavedza said that Mackenzie, leader of the Good News International Church, bore the “primary... item.title: British Ebola patient evacuated from DR Congo arrives at London hospital
item.description: Doctor who was helping response to outbreak in Africa taken to specialist isolation unit at Royal Free hospital A British doctor who tested positive for Ebola while working in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has returned to the UK for specialist treatment. The patient, whose identity is unknown, was transported home on a medical evacuation flight , the Department of Health and Social Care said on Thursday. They are now being cared for in a specialised high-level isolation unit at the Royal Free hospital in Hampstead, north London. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Star mathematician Ma Xiao leaves the US for China – and a career pivot to AI
item.description: Two years ago, Chinese mathematician Ma Xiao helped crack a century-old puzzle known as Hilbert’s sixth problem. The problem – which has baffled generations of mathematical physicists – centres on an elusive bridge connecting the chaotic frenzy of microscopic atoms with the predictable laws of fluid motion. The breakthrough, published in the Annals of Mathematics, helped propel Ma’s collaborator Deng Yu to the 2026 Fields Medal – the discipline’s highest honour – and secured Ma a coveted faculty... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.description: León XIV tiene previsto iniciar este viernes 6 de noviembre uno de los viajes al extranjero más ambiciosos de un pontífice en décadas: visitar Uruguay, Argentina y su país de adopción, Perú, a pesar de haber sido operado recientemente de cáncer de pulmón. El papa llevará en su primera gira latinoamericana un mensaje centrado en la defensa de la vida, el apoyo a los más vulnerables y la reducción de las desigualdades. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
